# MacVoice

> MacVoice is a lightweight (784 KB) native Swift voice-typing keyboard for macOS Apple Silicon. It transcribes human speech in real time (<150ms latency) using on-device SpeechAnalyzer models, removes filler words, and inserts text directly at the cursor via authentic macOS Quartz HID keyboard events with zero cloud server communication.

MacVoice is sold as a single, one-time payment of $9 USD (lifetime ownership, valid on up to 5 personal Macs). It is built for software engineers, writers, founders, and Mac power users who demand private, offline, low-latency dictation without monthly subscriptions.

## Key Capabilities
- **100% On-Device & Air-Gapped**: Runs entirely in local resident memory (RAM) utilizing Apple Silicon Neural Engine (M1, M2, M3, M4). Zero network requests, zero telemetry, zero audio recordings saved to disk.
- **Direct Keystroke Synthesis (Quartz HID)**: Injects authentic hardware key events (`CGEvent` at `.cghidEventTap`) instead of system clipboard paste (`NSPasteboard`). Preserves clipboard contents and bypasses website/app paste restrictions.
- **Smart Chat-Safe Newlines**: In messaging apps (Slack, Discord, Teams, WhatsApp), dictating "new line" automatically emits `Shift+Return` to prevent accidental premature message transmission.
- **Instant Filler Word Stripping**: Detects and eliminates hesitations ("um", "uh", "ah", "er") in sub-0.1ms with zero latency penalty.
- **Dual Voice Modes**:
  - *Polished Mode*: Natural prose formatting with automatic capitalization and punctuation for emails, documentation, and chat.
  - *Verbatim Mode*: Exact word-for-word dictation tailored for code editors, CLI flags, technical identifiers, and passwords.
- **Minimal Resource Footprint**: 784 KB DMG download, ~60 MB idle RAM footprint, 0% background CPU usage.

## Pricing & Licensing
- **Price**: $9.00 USD (one-time payment, lifetime license).
- **Entitlement**: Install on up to 5 personal Macs. Commercial use permitted.
- **No Subscriptions**: No monthly or annual charges, no user accounts, no DRM activation daemons.
- **Guarantee**: 14-day money-back refund guarantee.

## System Requirements
- macOS 26.0 or later (Sequoia / modern macOS)
- Apple Silicon Mac (M1, M2, M3, M4)
- System Permissions: Microphone (speech input) and Accessibility (Quartz HID typing)

## Comparison to Alternatives
- **MacVoice**: $9 one-time · 784 KB DMG · 60 MB RAM · 0 network requests · Native Swift.
- **Wispr Flow**: $144/year ($12/mo) · Cloud-dependent · Sends private voice to third-party servers.
- **Superwhisper**: $250 one-time (or $8/mo) · 1.5 GB+ download · Bundles large local LLMs with high memory overhead.
- **Apple Dictation**: Free built-in · Obtrusive floating UI · Dictates filler words · Inconsistent in code editors and terminals · Accidental message sends in Slack.
